 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Anjani Kumar Sharan
 Oral Order
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under Sections 16(i)(a) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Rules, 1955 pending in the learned court below.

As per the prosecution case, the informant, Food Inspector, alleging on 16.11.2009 at 1:30 P.M.
visited the place of occurrence and took sample of 'chana dal' which was sent for chemical analysis and in the chemical analysis sample of 'chana dal' was found sub-standard and adulterous in quality.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.63211 of 2022(2) dt.12-01-2023 case.
He submits that there is no specific overt act against the petitioner.
He further submits that similarly situated other co- accused person has already been granted bail by the learned lower court itself and Section 82 Cr.P.C. has been issued against the petitioner.
He submits that the summon is not received by the petitioner because he is living in Delhi.
He further submits that petitioner has got one criminal antecedent as stated in para- 3 of the bail application.

sentences.text: Learned APP for the State opposes for prayer for bail.

Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, let the petitioner, named above, in the event of his arrest/surrender before the learned court below within a period of six weeks from today, be released on anticipatory bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Court below, where the case is pending/Successor court, in connection with P.S. Case No.146/2010, subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438 (2)
of the Cr.P.C.
(Anjani Kumar Sharan, J) ajay/-
